analyst.summary: Supreme Industries is India's largest maker of plastic pipes and fittings, with a diversified set of smaller plastics businesses alongside its core piping franchise. The company is financially very strong -- virtually debt-free, with healthy returns on capital and a steady dividend -- and the most recent quarter showed a strong profit recovery after a period in which raw-material (PVC resin) price swings and slower government infrastructure spending had pressured the piping business. The stock has fallen meaningfully over the past one and two years even as the business kept growing, but remains richly valued on conventional measures. We rate it a Hold: an excellent, financially pristine market leader, but not yet a bargain even after the recent de-rating.
